name: Passkey Sign-in
description: A passkey sign-in card with a hand-drawn fingerprint: a scan line sweeps it while the device answers, and on success it lights from the core outward.

props.name: onAuthenticate
props.description: Runs the WebAuthn ceremony. Resolve to sign in. Reject with NotAllowedError or AbortError for a calm cancel, anything else for the error state. Defaults to a 2.4s simulated success.

props.name: onSuccess
props.description: Called once the success animation has settled (about 1.4s).

props.name: onFallback
props.description: “Use email instead”, and the primary action when passkeys are unsupported.

props.name: supported
props.description: Force passkey support on or off. Undefined feature-detects window.PublicKeyCredential.

props.name: timeoutMs
props.description: Abort the ceremony and show the timed-out state after this long.

props.name: credentialHint
props.description: Quiet mono line under the glyph while idle.
